name: Userology
description_en:
Userology is an AI-moderated research platform for interviews and usability studies with human participants. Its workflow combines study setup, recruitment, adaptive follow-up questions and analysis of recordings and transcripts.

The AI is the moderator, not the respondent. Study design, participant suitability and checking the resulting interpretations remain human responsibilities; an AI summary is not independent research validation.
description_zh:
Userology 是以人类参与者开展访谈及可用性研究的 AI 主持平台，结合研究配置、招募、动态追问及录制转录分析。

AI 担任主持人，而非受访者。研究设计、参与者是否适合及结果解释核查仍由人负责，AI 摘要不是独立研究验证。

core_features.explanation_zh: AI 主持人围绕研究任务向人类参与者追问。

core_features.explanation_en: Video, transcripts and clips support checking generated summaries.
core_features.explanation_zh: 用视频、转录和片段核对生成摘要。

sections.title_en: AI moderation of real participant sessions
sections.title_zh: 由 AI 主持真实参与者研究
sections.en: The homepage describes supplying objectives, drafting an interview guide, testing products or prototypes and receiving participant video, transcripts, clips and reports. The live-product page describes questions adapting to participant actions. Claims of bias elimination, speed or consistency are marketing statements rather than independent measurements in this profile. Do not assign every footer item to a released method when beta/coming-soon labels are present.
sections.zh: 首页介绍提供目标、起草访谈提纲、测试产品或原型，以及获得参与者视频、转录、片段和报告。实时产品页介绍按参与者行动调整问题。消除偏差、速度和一致性均属宣传，本次未独立测量。页脚有 beta 和即将推出标识，不能把每项都当成已发布方法。

sections.title_en: Example: understand a confusing onboarding step
sections.title_zh: 示例：理解有歧义的入门步骤
sections.en: Provide a prototype, a neutral task and the specific question you want to understand, then pilot a session with an appropriate participant. Review where the AI follows up, whether it leads the answer and whether the participant could access the material. Compare summary claims with video and transcript before changing the design. Unexpected or contradictory answers should remain visible rather than being smoothed into a single narrative. No study was run here.
sections.zh: 提供原型、中性任务及具体研究问题，再用合适参与者试点。检查 AI 在哪里追问、是否诱导，以及参与者能否访问材料。改设计前，应把摘要主张与视频转录核对。意外或相互矛盾的回答应保留，不能被归纳成单一叙事。本文未实际运行研究。

sections.title_en: Session fee plus an unresolved access fee
sections.title_zh: 场次费及未明的接入费
sections.en: The public pricing iframe lists pay-as-you-go sessions at $20, without a recurring subscription or seat limit. Its FAQ also requires a one-time platform access fee but gives no amount. That prevents a complete first-purchase total. Research+ directs buyers to sales for support and enterprise needs. Confirm what counts as a completed billable session, recruitment/incentives, access fee and failed-session treatment before ordering. A free-trial button does not establish ongoing free research.
sections.zh: 公开定价 iframe 列按次每场 20 美元，无持续订阅或席位上限；FAQ 又要求一次性平台接入费，但未公布金额，因此无法给出完整首购总额。Research+ 的支持和企业需求需询价。下单前需明确计费完成场次定义、招募激励、接入费及失败场次处理。免费试用按钮不代表持续免费研究。

sections.title_en: Use a pilot before scaling recruitment
sections.en: Start with one research objective and a non-sensitive asset, check the AI guide and inspect the pilot evidence before recruiting a larger audience. Userology may fit repeated qualitative sessions where follow-up is useful; it does not ensure that AI moderation suits every sensitive or specialist discussion. Source licensing, exact retention, participant consent, contractual privacy and export fidelity remain unverified.
sections.zh: 先确定一个研究目标及非敏感材料，检查 AI 提纲和试点证据后再扩大招募。它可能适合需要追问的重复定性研究，但不保证 AI 主持适合所有敏感或专业讨论。源码许可、保留期限、参与者同意、合同隐私及导出保真仍未核实。
